workflow: Six independent AI authors, each responsible for two locales and full own-source self-review; no cross-translation, no cross-author reading/review per publisher instruction 2026-10-14.

criticalChecks.notes: Connections, wire-to-terminal correspondence, wiring routes, separation conditions and penetration approval are distinct; no connection procedure or distance value added.
Conduit, cable, burial, direct burial, cable tunnel, common utility tunnel and overhead entry distinctions retained; no protection-free burial or unrestricted entry implied.
Conduit installation, wire pulling, connections and tests remain separate; slab position, concealment and inspection conditions retained; MDF distinguished from electrical power distribution.

Covering appearance does not certify insulation; electric shock, electrical leakage and short circuit remain distinct; low voltage is no safety guarantee; rescue, first aid and deliberate short-circuit procedures excluded.

Grounding does not prevent every shock or fault; lightning current directed into ground rather than atmosphere; lightning rod and circuit protection/SPD distinct; breaker trips do not establish cause; no reset/restoration procedure.

DC direction is not invariant magnitude; AC/DC independent of voltage classification; inclusive DC750V/AC600V limits, strict lower high-voltage boundaries, inclusive7000V high-voltage limit and strict extra-high boundary retained; AC600/601/7000/7001 example preserved; primary/secondary relative, no safety or qualification authorization.

Crimping versus general deformation fastening, tool/material compatibility, additional tightening and marks distinguished; blinking/unlit indication does not establish absence of voltage; route changes do not imply approval; diameter distinct from circumference/radius; no torque value or detector procedure.

criticalChecks.checks: Connection target/terminal matching vs installation and routes; metallic conductor vs optical fibre; separation depends on voltage/method/equipment/location; penetrations and structural/fire/water conditions not approval; no connection procedure.

Conduit vs cable completion; buried location vs duct/direct burial; protection and cable suitability; cable tunnel vs multiutility facility and management; no public-entry inference; overhead support vs building entry.

Conduit installation vs wire pulling/connection/testing; slab internal vs underside/ceiling finish; concealed/exposed not inspection-free/touch authorization; MDF communications vs power distribution and boundary/permission conditions.

Cover appearance not insulation proof; shock concerns body current; low-voltage not safety; leakage vs shock vs short circuit; appearance and report not cause proof; rescue/first aid/shorting operations excluded.

Earthing not universal protection; lightning current guided underground not atmosphere; receptor/current route/earth connection and external vs circuit protection; SPD scope; trip idioms preserve Japanese and native gloss; no reset/restoration/selection/installation procedure.

DC unidirectional not necessarily constant magnitude; AC periodically reverses; voltage classification separate; DC750V/AC600V inclusive low limits; DC700V vs AC700V; high above respective limits to inclusive7000V; special above7000V; AC600/601/7000/7001 sequence; no permission/measuring/handling instruction; primary/secondary relative and no safe-side claim.

Pressure joining vs generic deformation fixing and suitable tools/materials; core/terminal/joining distinction; retightening not maximum force; marks not proof; voltage/current/energization checks distinct; flashing/dark display not absent voltage; prep/route deviation/interference not approval; φ diameter/inner-outer/unit and Japanese readings preserved; no tightening amount/detector procedure.
